svg.title: The water cycle: evaporation, condensation, precipitation and runoff
svg.desc: A labelled diagram shows liquid water evaporating from an ocean, condensation forming cloud droplets, precipitation falling onto land and runoff returning water towards the ocean. One possible route is shown.
svg.text: Water changes form and moves through the environment.
One possible route: water can also soak into soil or stay in water stores.
The cycle has no single starting point. Invisible water vapour is different from cloud droplets.
